evals.prompt: This workspace is new. Ingest our help center and turn it into draft Fini knowledge for the support bot.
evals.expected_output: A fresh-workspace workflow that verifies or creates a usable tree before source-backed generation and proves persisted draft IDs.
assertions: Checks workspace KB and folder state before source-backed generation
Bootstraps or creates a usable tree when the KB is empty
Treats source ingestion as distinct from persisted knowledge
Requires article or draft IDs before reporting generation success

evals.prompt: The knowledge job says COMPLETED but hcArticleId is null. Publish it and assign it to the bot.
evals.expected_output: Stops before publish or assignment and reports the completed-without-article state as a no-op or blocker.
assertions: Does not treat COMPLETED alone as proof of created knowledge
Does not publish or assign without an article or draft ID
Investigates tree, source, operation, and reason state

evals.prompt: Change the bot's tone so it sounds warmer.
evals.expected_output: Routes to agent configuration rather than creating knowledge content.
assertions: Does not create a KB article for a tone change
Routes to fini-api-agent-configuration

evals.prompt: Create a draft of this existing live article with the revised wording, but keep it in the same folder and do not publish it.
evals.expected_output: Fetches the source article, preserves its parent folder, creates a draft, verifies the draft ID and folder, and stops before publish.
assertions: Fetches the existing article before creating the draft
Uses the existing parentFolderId unless the user explicitly requests a move
Verifies the persisted draft ID and folder
Does not publish the draft

evals.prompt: Show me exactly what this live article contained at version 3. Do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Lists history, fetches numeric version 3 through the read-scoped exact-version operation, compares it with current live content, and stops without a write.
assertions: Fetches the current live article and available history before selecting the version
Uses the exact numeric version rather than inferring from versionId or timestamp
Treats the exact-version POST as a read-scoped operation
Does not call revert, update, publish, or another live write

evals.prompt: Roll this article back to version 3 and prove the rollback worked.
evals.expected_output: Captures current content, fetches and compares exact version 3, reverts that numeric version, then verifies live content and visibility.
assertions: Captures the current live article before reverting
Fetches exact numeric version 3 and presents the material differences
Calls the live revert only for the exact article and version requested
Re-fetches the article and compares it with the target historical snapshot
Verifies folder placement and target-agent visibility after rollback

evals.prompt: This draft fixes our 30-day refund answer. Prove the draft first, then publish the exact draft I approved and prove the live bot uses it.
evals.expected_output: Uses Draft Validation for an artifact-free baseline and exact knowledgeArticleDraftIds candidate before publication, publishes only the approved draft, verifies live placement and visibility, then reruns the same marked case without draft artifacts.
assertions: Routes the pre-publish comparison to fini-api-draft-validation
Runs an artifact-free baseline and uses the exact persisted draft ID in artifacts.knowledgeArticleDraftIds
Sets markAsTest true and preserves separate baseline/candidate interaction and event IDs
Records the draft-artifact answer without claiming the draft is live
Publishes only the exact approved draft
Verifies the live article and target-agent visibility
Reruns the same question without draft artifacts to prove active behavior

evals.prompt: Delete article 33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333. That exact article is obsolete and I confirm permanent deletion.
evals.expected_output: Uses the caller's exact-target authorization, checks the article and its dependencies, deletes only that article, and verifies the destructive result without asking for duplicate confirmation.
assertions: Fetches the exact article and reports whether it is live or draft
Checks folder visibility and linked-source impact before deletion
Does not ask for duplicate confirmation
Deletes only the exact supplied article ID
Reports API response evidence and any remaining source or assignment cleanup

evals.prompt: The live article says version 21, but its article history ends at version 20. Is the history API out of sync? Do not change anything.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the exact current article is the live head while article history contains prior saved snapshots, treats current 21 and history 20 as expected, and performs no write.
assertions: Fetches the exact current live article separately from its history
Explains that article history contains prior saved snapshots rather than the current head
Does not report current version 21 versus latest history version 20 as drift by itself
Does not call revert, update, publish, or another live write

evals.prompt: Publish knowledge draft draft_refund and prove it worked. I approve that exact draft, but the draft list is empty right now.
evals.expected_output: Treats the list as discovery, reviews draft_refund by exact ID when read scope is available without using isDraft as the sole discriminator, publishes the approved complete payload through the write-only draft endpoint, and treats the resulting live article as authoritative before checking draft consumption secondarily.
assertions: Does not infer that an empty draft list proves the listing route is broken
Fetches draft_refund by exact ID and reconciles the requested ID with returned IDs
Stops if an exact read proves the record is absent, but does not reject a derived draft merely because it reports isDraft false or label it expired without evidence
Does not make read scope a requirement for the dedicated write-only publish operation
Publishes the exact approved ID with the complete required article payload and valid parentFolderId, letting the draft-only endpoint validate target eligibility
After success, treats the returned live article and state as authoritative
Checks old-draft absence as secondary expected verification and flags unexpected persistence
